title: Cross-AZ internal ingress Terraform module with optional mTLS termination and advanced health probes
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to provision internal load balancing for Private (VPC) deployments. The module should support an NLB fronting one or more ALBs (NLB->ALB pattern) for internal-only ingress, provide configurable TLS termination (including optional mutual TLS), and expose fine-grained health probe configuration so services can achieve fast failover without spurious restarts. The module must include a documented upgrade/migration path from the legacy internal-ingress stack and CI tests that validate cross-AZ failover and health-check edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Module deploys an internal NLB + ALB chain in a customer VPC with no public IPs by default
TLS termination configurable at ALB with optional client-cert mTLS offload; certs can be supplied via ARN (ACM) or integrated with customer KMS/HSM for private certs
Health checks configurable per-target-group including healthy/unhealthy thresholds, interval, timeout and optional TCP-level probe on NLB; supports soft-failover grace period
Support for cross-AZ target registration and sticky session configuration for legacy workloads
Terraform 1.5+ compatible, uses remote state-friendly resource naming and avoids non-deterministic IDs
Clear upgrade guide and state migration example for teams moving from legacy internal-ingress module to this module
End-to-end tests in CI validate: TLS handshake, mTLS client cert validation, ALB target draining behavior, and health-check-driven failover across AZs
Module includes example usage for: single-AZ test VPC, multi-AZ production VPC, and Dedicated deployment with reserved subnets
comments: 2026-02-18 - Aisha Khan: Created ticket. Initial scope focused on NLB->ALB internal pattern, TLS termination options, and health checks. Flagging potential compatibility issues with existing customer terraform state. Linking design doc in Confluence.

2026-02-22 - Diego Morales: Spiked two prototypes: 1) ALB-only internal solution and 2) NLB fronting ALB. Found the NLB->ALB pattern is required for TCP passthrough metrics and IP-based access control. Decided to proceed with NLB->ALB as default.

2026-03-01 - Diego Morales: Design review notes: must expose listener rules for path-based routing, allow optional preserve-client-ip via proxy protocol on NLB, and include security group templates for strict VPC-only access. @PM-review requested for rollout constraints.

2026-03-04 - Priya Singh (PM): Approved scope given Dedicated customers need predictable throughput. Requested explicit knobs for autoscaling target group settings and a knob to disable ALB access logs for privacy-sensitive customers.

2026-03-06 - Eng review: Identified a breaking change when switching target type from instance -> ip for some on-prem connectors. Plan: provide migration helper that creates new target groups and performs cutover with minimal downtime.

2026-03-08 - Diego Morales: Initial implementation PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules/pull/789. Terraform module skeleton, examples, and basic ALB/NLB wiring included. Pending: mTLS implementation and CI e2e tests.

2026-03-10 - Security review kickoff: Security team requested threat model for mTLS key management, guidance for certificate rotation, and audit logging of failed client certs. Added to acceptance criteria and security checklist.
2026-03-10 - QA: Drafted test plan for CI e2e: create ephemeral VPC, deploy module, simulate target failures, verify traffic re-routes within 30s, validate Certificate rotation scenario.
